snippet.title: Encrafted Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a trailer for the upcoming game "Encrafted", it is a fun and chill roguelike deckbuilder game akin to Balatro where you combine materials to make valuable products to sell and clear rounds. It is as cosy and relaxing game but you can definitely push the limits of the game if you feel like it. There are no limits to how powerful you can get with upgrades in Encrafted.

Artefacts are passive items that have powerful effects, like adding value to crafts or multiplying the value of your final sale values!

The Demo for Encrafted is available right now on Steam!

Wishlist it on Steam! :)

Game, Art, and Trailer by Riley J. Gray.
Music by Jordan Clark.
